eras.name_zh: 第 1–24 轮 · 早期探索
eras.desc_en: NEP89 benchmark, continuous multi-TS searches, the κ-dimer and isosurface-constrained studies, then bond-length drives. Grand final 1 (r14) and grand final 2 (r24) on six early systems.
eras.desc_zh: NEP89 基准、连续多过渡态搜索、κ-dimer 与等值面约束研究，随后是键长驱动；早期六个体系上的总决赛 1（r14）与总决赛 2（r24）。

eras.name_zh: 第 25–54 轮 · 第一波并行
eras.desc_en: Parallel agents per round; the long-best preset is born. Grand final 3 (r54) on 36 initial states.
eras.desc_zh: 每轮一个并行子 agent；long-best 预设诞生。总决赛 3（r54），36 个初态。

eras.name_en: Rounds 55–154 · Exact Hessians and fair baselines
eras.name_zh: 第 55–154 轮 · 精确 Hessian 与公平基线
eras.desc_en: Exact-Hessian certificates, G-FACTORY test sets, Sella on metals (long-best-auto), fair baselines. Grand finals 4 (r89), 5 (r117) and 6 (r150).
eras.desc_zh: 精确 Hessian 证书、G-FACTORY 测试集、金属上用 Sella（long-best-auto）、公平基线。总决赛 4（r89）、5（r117）、6（r150）。

eras.name_zh: 第 155–289 轮 · 算法解剖、新技巧与 v0.80
eras.desc_en: Dissecting where calls go, new algorithms and tricks, Sella FAIR/FAIR-PLUS baselines. Grand final 7 (r255) and the v0.80.0 default switch (r260–r261), then post-release rounds.
eras.desc_zh: 解剖调用去向、新算法与新技巧、Sella FAIR/FAIR-PLUS 基线。总决赛 7（r255）与 v0.80.0 默认切换（r260–r261），之后为发布后各轮。

eras.name_zh: 第 290–389 轮 · 深度理解、GF8 与 v0.81
eras.desc_en: Mechanism-first rounds, G-FACTORY-5, DFT cost model and a real Quantum ESPRESSO demo, cross-pool audits, sealed grand final 8 (r385) and v0.81 opt-in presets.
eras.desc_zh: 先理解机制再创新的各轮、G-FACTORY-5、DFT 计价与真实 QE 演示、跨池审计、密封总决赛 8（r385）与 v0.81 可选预设。

glossary.def_en: The relaxed starting minimum: an adsorbate on a metal surface or a guest molecule in a zeolite pore.
glossary.def_zh: 弛豫好的起始极小：金属表面上的吸附物，或分子筛孔道里的客体分子。

glossary.def_en: The mountain pass between two valleys: a stationary point whose Hessian has exactly one negative eigenvalue.
glossary.def_zh: 两个山谷之间的山口：Hessian 恰有一个负本征值的驻点。

glossary.def_en: The minimum reached by sliding down from the TS on the side away from the IS.
glossary.def_zh: 从过渡态向远离初态的一侧下坡所到达的极小。

glossary.def_en: Number of distinct, strictly certified saddles (exact Hessian with exactly one negative eigenvalue) that connect downhill to the IS.
glossary.def_zh: 严格认证（精确 Hessian 恰有一个负本征值）且下坡连回初态的不同鞍点数。

glossary.def_en: One NEP89 energy + force evaluation. Every call is charged, including validation; exact Hessians are charged as call equivalents.
glossary.def_zh: 一次 NEP89 能量 + 力计算。所有调用都计费（含验证）；精确 Hessian 按力调用当量计费。

glossary.def_en: One geometry update of an optimiser or walker. U per ionic step is the ranking metric requested by the user.
glossary.def_zh: 优化器或行走者的一次几何更新。每离子步的独立鞍点是用户指定的排名指标。

glossary.def_en: A cost model (r294): each exact Hessian is re-priced as 3·N_free force calls, i.e. finite differences under DFT. Not measured SCF time.
glossary.def_zh: 成本模型（r294）：每个精确 Hessian 改按 DFT 有限差分 3·N_free 次力调用计价；不是实测 SCF 时间。

glossary.def_en: Bootstrap over initial-state clusters (4,000 resamples). A ratio whose interval contains 1.0 shows no detectable effect.
glossary.def_zh: 按初态聚类的自助法（4,000 次重采样）。区间包含 1.0 的比值表示没有可检测的效果。

glossary.term_zh: 开发集 / 确认池 / 密封集
glossary.def_en: Mechanisms are tuned on development sets, confirmed once on a held-out pool, and compared on sealed sets that open only at a grand final.
glossary.def_zh: 机制在开发集上调试，在留出池上只确认一次，并在只于总决赛打开的密封集上比较。

glossary.def_en: TS-first cases come from a literature reaction with a known reference saddle and product; IS-first cases only have the initial state, like a real user.
glossary.def_zh: 先过渡态案例来自文献反应，有已知参考鞍点与产物；先初态案例只有初态，和真实用户一样。

glossary.def_en: Two images a small distance apart act as a pair of feet: rotating them finds the lowest-curvature direction, and the walker climbs along it while relaxing all other directions.
glossary.def_zh: 两个相距很近的像像一双脚：转动它们找到曲率最低的方向，沿该方向上爬，同时在其余方向上弛豫。

glossary.def_en: TSASE variant that blends the perpendicular and uphill forces with a sigmoid of κ = −λ/|g| (curvature over gradient). Studied in rounds 1–24; as a stand-alone search it rarely reached connected saddles on NEP89.
glossary.def_zh: TSASE 的变体：用 κ = −λ/|g|（曲率与梯度之比）的 S 形函数混合垂直力与上坡力。第 1–24 轮研究过；单独使用时在 NEP89 上很少得到连通鞍点。

glossary.def_en: A trust-region saddle optimiser (RS-PRFO) that keeps an updated Hessian. Used on metal surfaces inside long-best-auto, and as the FAIR / FAIR-PLUS baselines.
glossary.def_zh: 带 Hessian 更新的信赖域鞍点优化器（RS-PRFO）。在 long-best-auto 中用于金属表面，也作为 FAIR / FAIR-PLUS 基线。

glossary.def_en: Stretch or compress one interatomic distance step by step while relaxing everything else; where the energy turns over, a walker is launched toward the true saddle.
glossary.def_zh: 逐步拉长或压缩某个原子间距，其余自由度弛豫；能量由升转降处，放出行走者去找真正的鞍点。

glossary.def_en: From a candidate saddle, slide down both sides along the negative mode; it counts only if one side returns to the IS and the other reaches a different minimum.
glossary.def_zh: 从候选鞍点沿负模两侧下坡；只有一侧回到初态、另一侧到达不同极小时才计数。

key_points.en: 4.97× more certified saddles per force call than an EON-style global search (random displacement + dimer), and 2.88× per ionic step, on the sealed GF8 set: 54 never-run initial states × 2 seeds.
key_points.zh: 在密封 GF8 集（54 个从未运行过的初态 × 2 个种子）上，比 EON 式全局搜索（随机位移 + dimer）每次力调用多找 4.97 倍认证鞍点，每离子步 2.88 倍。

key_points.en: Against the strongest fair baseline, Sella FAIR-PLUS (random multi-start Sella + dedup, same validator): 1.48× [1.22, 1.83] per call; per ionic step 1.18× [0.98, 1.44], not significant.
key_points.zh: 对最强公平基线 Sella FAIR-PLUS（随机多起点 Sella + 去重，同一验证器）：每次调用 1.48 倍 [1.22, 1.83]；每离子步 1.18 倍 [0.98, 1.44]，不显著。

key_points.en: Most efficient per force call: the opt-in full stack long-best-auto-81-fullstack-optin, 1.144× the default (zeolites 1.242×). Highest saddles per ionic step: long-lowbarrier-auto-81 (saddles ≤ 1.5 eV only).
key_points.zh: 每次力调用效率最高：可选全栈 long-best-auto-81-fullstack-optin，为默认的 1.144 倍（分子筛 1.242 倍）。每离子步鞍点最多：long-lowbarrier-auto-81（只计 ≤ 1.5 eV）。

key_points.en: The CLI default stays long-best-auto-80: bond-coordinate relaxed scan → Sella on metals, dimer elsewhere → exact-Hessian certificate + two-sided downhill validation. v0.81 presets are opt-in.
key_points.zh: CLI 默认保持 long-best-auto-80：键坐标松弛扫描 → 金属用 Sella、其余用 dimer → 精确 Hessian 认证 + 双侧下坡验证。v0.81 预设为可选项。

key_points.en: Honest limits: all numbers are on the NEP89 surface. The real Quantum ESPRESSO demo (r325) has not yet shown NEP→DFT savings, and on 85 development states the default's two-seed union covers about 490 of 1,296 strict saddles found by an exhaustive census. The search is efficient, not exhaustive.
key_points.zh: 诚实的局限：所有数字都在 NEP89 势能面上。真实 QE 演示（r325）尚未证明 NEP→DFT 的节省；在 85 个开发初态上，穷举普查找到 1,296 个严格鞍点，默认两种子并集只覆盖约 490 个。搜索是高效的，但不是穷举的。

key_points.en: Method: each round pre-registers its test, screens on development sets and confirms once on a held-out pool; sealed sets open only at grand finals. Negative results are kept: in campaign 4, 38 of 100 rounds were negative and 8 more inconclusive.
key_points.zh: 方法学：每轮预注册检验、在开发集上筛选、在留出池上只确认一次；密封集只在总决赛打开。阴性结果全部保留：第四阶段 100 轮中 38 轮阴性，另有 8 轮不确定。

ranking.desc_en: Low-barrier window (≤ 1.5 eV) + two-witness local energy-cap memory
ranking.desc_zh: 低能垒窗口（≤ 1.5 eV）+ 两见证的局部能量上限记忆
ranking.vivid_en: A guide who only looks for low passes and keeps a notebook of energy ceilings seen nearby, so climbs that go too high are dropped early.
ranking.vivid_zh: 只找低山口的向导，并记下附近见过的能量“天花板”，爬得太高就提前放弃。

ranking.vivid_en: The default guide told to ignore passes higher than 1.5 eV.
ranking.vivid_zh: 默认向导，但被告知忽略高于 1.5 eV 的山口。

ranking.desc_en: v0.80 + SAFE4: non-metal bent-endpoint recovery, walk step limit, guarded one-sided validation, Sella stall cutoff
ranking.desc_zh: v0.80 + SAFE4：非金属弯曲端点恢复、行走限幅、带护栏单侧判定、Sella 停滞截断
ranking.vivid_en: The default plus four safety habits: rescue bent endpoints, shorten the stride, accept a one-sided proof only behind guard rails, and stop Sella when it stalls.
ranking.vivid_zh: 默认方法加四个安全习惯：救回弯曲端点、缩短步幅、只在护栏下接受单侧证明、Sella 停滞就停。

ranking.desc_en: Conservative candidate + zeolite TGW stack (Lanczos recurrence gate, Sella tail to 3N = 2000) + model-based rotation
ranking.desc_zh: 保守候选 + 分子筛 TGW 栈（Lanczos 复发闸、Sella 尾段到 3N = 2000）+ 模型化转动
ranking.vivid_en: SAFE4 plus a zeolite toolkit: a gate that stops repeated Lanczos rotations, a longer Sella finish, and a model that predicts the dimer's turn instead of measuring it every time.
ranking.vivid_zh: SAFE4 再加分子筛工具包：阻止重复 Lanczos 转动的闸门、更长的 Sella 收尾，以及用模型预测 dimer 的转向、不必每次实测。

ranking.desc_en: Bond-coordinate relaxed scan → Sella on metals, dimer elsewhere → exact-Hessian certificate + two-sided downhill validation
ranking.desc_zh: 键坐标松弛扫描 → 金属 Sella、其余 dimer → 精确 Hessian 认证 + 双侧下坡验证
ranking.vivid_en: A guided crossing: pull one chemical bond like a rope to find the ridge, let a specialist climber finish (Sella on metals, the two-legged dimer elsewhere), then a surveyor certifies the pass and walks down both sides to prove it leads home.
ranking.vivid_zh: 带向导的翻山：先像拉绳子一样拉一根化学键找到山脊，再让专业登山者冲顶（金属用 Sella，其余用“两只脚”的 dimer），最后测量员认证山口并沿两侧下山，确认能回到起点。

ranking.vivid_en: The extra-scouts preset with the four safety habits.
ranking.vivid_zh: “多派侦察兵”预设加上四个安全习惯。

ranking.desc_en: Default + gradient-extremum starts, site hopping, re-walk with the other engine; finds more saddles
ranking.desc_zh: 默认 + 梯度极值起点、位点跳跃、另一引擎重走，多找鞍点
ranking.vivid_en: Send extra scouts: start from gradient extremes, hop to neighbouring sites and re-walk promising paths with the other engine. More passes per command, slightly less per step.
ranking.vivid_zh: 多派侦察兵：从梯度极值出发、跳到相邻位点、用另一种引擎重走有希望的路。每条命令找到更多山口，每步效率略低。

ranking.desc_en: Plain Sella with random multi-start + dedup, same validator and accounting
ranking.desc_zh: 原版 Sella 随机多起点 + 去重，同一验证器与计费
ranking.vivid_en: Drop a skilled climber at random spots around the start, let plain Sella climb to the nearest pass, repeat and remove duplicates.
ranking.vivid_zh: 把熟练的登山者随机放在起点周围，让原版 Sella 爬到最近的山口，重复多次并去重。

ranking.desc_zh: 键坐标扫描 + dimer，不用 Sella
ranking.vivid_en: The guided crossing without the Sella specialist: rope-pull scan, then the dimer climbs everywhere.
ranking.vivid_zh: 没有 Sella 专家的带向导翻山：拉绳扫描后全部由 dimer 冲顶。

ranking.desc_en: Random local Gaussian displacement + ASE dimer (fair implementation from r337, ≤ 16,000 calls per IS)
ranking.desc_zh: 随机局部高斯位移 + ASE dimer（第 337 轮公平实现，每初态至多 16,000 次调用）
ranking.vivid_en: Blindfolded hiking: kick the atoms randomly near the start and let a dimer climb from wherever they land — the classic global saddle search.
ranking.vivid_zh: 蒙眼登山：在起点附近随机踢一下原子，再让 dimer 从落脚处往上爬——经典的全局鞍点搜索。

en.title: NEP89 saddle-search lab — 389 rounds explained
en.description: Bilingual explorer of 389 rounds of transition-state search algorithm development on the NEP89 potential: every round explained, test systems with initial, transition and final structures, efficiencies and the final ranking.

zh.title: NEP89 鞍点搜索实验室 — 389 轮全解读
zh.description: 在 NEP89 势上进行的 389 轮过渡态搜索算法研发：逐轮形象解读、测试体系（初态/过渡态/终态结构）、效率与最终排名。

EARLY.desc_en: The original development systems of rounds 1–24: S1 methoxy/Cu(111), S2 formic acid/Pt(111), S3 ethylene glycol and glycolaldehyde + 2H/Pt(111), X1 n-butane/H-MFI, Z1 two methanol/H-CHA, Z2 two ethanol/H-MFI (dry, and with two water). N- and N2- cases are reaction-network nodes one or two steps away. Initial states only: the saddles are what the search must find.
EARLY.desc_zh: 第 1–24 轮的原始开发体系：S1 甲氧基/Cu(111)、S2 甲酸/Pt(111)、S3 乙二醇与乙醇醛 + 2H/Pt(111)、X1 正丁烷/H-MFI、Z1 两个甲醇/H-CHA、Z2 两个乙醇/H-MFI（干燥与含两个水）。N-、N2- 开头的是距原体系一步或两步的反应网络节点。只有初态：鞍点要靠搜索去找。

GEN3.desc_en: Held-out new chemistry (N3-*): CO2 + 2H/Cu(211), NH3 + H/Ru(0001), CO + H/Rh(111), acetylene + 2H/Pd(111), propane/Pt(111), formaldehyde + methanol and propene in H-CHA, methanol + ethene in H-MFI. Initial states only.
GEN3.desc_zh: 留出的新化学（N3-*）：CO2 + 2H/Cu(211)、NH3 + H/Ru(0001)、CO + H/Rh(111)、乙炔 + 2H/Pd(111)、丙烷/Pt(111)、H-CHA 中的甲醛 + 甲醇与丙烯、H-MFI 中的甲醇 + 乙烯。只有初态。

GEN4.desc_en: Held-out generation 4 (N4-*): CH3/Ni(111), CO + O/Pd(100), H2O/Cu(110), NO/Rh(100), water in H-FAU, H-FER and H-MOR. Initial states only.
GEN4.desc_zh: 留出第 4 代（N4-*）：CH3/Ni(111)、CO + O/Pd(100)、H2O/Cu(110)、NO/Rh(100)，以及 H-FAU、H-FER、H-MOR 中的水。只有初态。

GEN5.desc_en: Held-out generation 5 (N5-*): C2H4 + 4H/Pt(111), CH3/Ir(211), CO2 + H/CuZn(211), ethanol proton transfer in H-MWW, ethyl/Pt3Sn(111), O + H + 3CO/Rh(111). Initial states only.
GEN5.desc_zh: 留出第 5 代（N5-*）：C2H4 + 4H/Pt(111)、CH3/Ir(211)、CO2 + H/CuZn(211)、H-MWW 中乙醇质子转移、乙基/Pt3Sn(111)、O + H + 3CO/Rh(111)。只有初态。

F1.desc_en: Literature reactions built TS-first: a reference saddle was located first and relaxed downhill to define the initial state and the product, so every case has a known reference TS and FS.
F1.desc_zh: 按文献反应“先过渡态”构建：先找到参考鞍点，再向两侧下坡弛豫得到初态与产物，因此每个案例都有已知的参考过渡态与终态。

F2.desc_en: Second TS-first factory with new hosts (hcp, fcc(110), bcc facets and more zeolites) and new reaction templates.
F2.desc_zh: 第二批“先过渡态”案例，加入新宿主（hcp、fcc(110)、bcc 晶面与更多分子筛）和新反应模板。

F3.desc_en: Third TS-first factory: further metals, facets and zeolite frameworks.
F3.desc_zh: 第三批“先过渡态”案例：更多金属、晶面与分子筛骨架。

IF.desc_en: Built only from an adsorbed molecule with the dimer-explore adsorb command, the way a user starts. No reference TS exists: every saddle must be discovered.
IF.desc_zh: 像用户一样只用 dimer-explore adsorb 放置分子得到初态，没有参考过渡态：所有鞍点都必须靠搜索发现。

F4.desc_en: Mixed TS-first and IS-first cases on alloys and high-index facets; the sealed part is confirmation pool P1.
F4.desc_zh: 合金与高指数晶面上的“先过渡态”与“先初态”混合案例；其密封部分即确认池 P1。

F5M.desc_en: Metals and alloys: single-atom alloys, vacancies, steps, hcp and bcc facets. Split by a pre-registered hash into confirmation pools P2/P3 and the sealed grand-final set S5. For the S5 cases the page also shows every distinct certified saddle the CLI default found in GF8.
F5M.desc_zh: 金属与合金：单原子合金、空位、台阶、hcp 与 bcc 晶面。按预注册哈希分成确认池 P2/P3 和密封总决赛集 S5。对 S5 案例，本页还给出 CLI 默认方法在 GF8 中找到的全部不同认证鞍点。

F5P.desc_en: Porous hosts: 18 new zeolite frameworks, split into P2/P3 and the sealed GF8 set S5 (with the saddles the CLI default found in GF8).
F5P.desc_zh: 多孔宿主：18 种新分子筛骨架，分成 P2/P3 与密封 GF8 集 S5（附 CLI 默认方法在 GF8 中找到的鞍点）。

DFT.desc_en: Quantum ESPRESSO on a 10-atom Cu(111) slab with O and H. The pre-registered comparison found no DFT-certified saddle in either arm; post hoc each route certified one channel, shown here.
DFT.desc_zh: Quantum ESPRESSO，10 原子 Cu(111) 板 + O、H。预注册比较两臂都没有得到 DFT 认证鞍点；事后两条路线各认证 1 个通道，即此处所示。

OTHER.desc_en: Oxides, MOFs, water layers, large adsorbates, slab-size tests and synthetic potentials (boundary tests).
OTHER.desc_zh: 氧化物、MOF、水层、大吸附物、板大小测试与合成势（边界测试）。
